senses.gloss: f. (v. בֶּגֶר) womanhood, (after twelve years and a half), opp. to נערות, maidenhood (between twelve and twelve and a half) and ילדות childhood (from three to twelve years).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:2:10">Y. Yeb. I, 3ᵃ</cite> top <he>אין בין … לימות הב׳ וכ׳</he> between the period of maidenhood and that of womanhood there is no more than a six months’ interval; <cite ref="Ketubot 39a:6">Keth. 39ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
